whoWeAre.heading: Vita Diet Up Close - Who We Are and What Sets Us Apart
whoWeAre.description: Vita Diet is a Saudi company providing exclusive agencies for high-quality European dietary supplements.
whoWeAre.footerText:
All our products are officially licensed by the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) and undergo strict scientific reviews before being added to our portfolio.
We do not deal directly with consumers, but rather serve approved pharmacies, distributors, and suppliers within the Kingdom.
